title: §.IX: Those canons are not owned by Crocius (Comm. LVI p.746) or even Mentzer the Lutheran
pass_a_gloss: besides that they are not acknowledged by the authors cited above, especially by John Crocius in his Commentary chapter 56 page 746, and even by Mentzer the Lutheran himself,
pass_b_english: Besides, the authors already cited do not own those canons — least of all John Crocius (Commentary, ch. 56, p. 746), and not even Mentzer the Lutheran.
source_text: praeterquam quòd, ab Auctoribus supra allegatis, sigillatim Joh. Crocio Comm. Cap. LVI. pag. 746. ab ipso etiam Mentzero Lutherano, non agnoscuntur,

lemmas.note: Crocius and Mentzer refuse the canons

choices.english: are not acknowledged / do not own
choices.why: refusal to recognize Dorsche's canons as theirs

notes: Hexades Annotationum six densify section 125; Pass A!=B; locked 1708 Latin PDF 210-212.
